content.text: Utah Community Programming As a mission-driven nonprofit arts organization that’s rooted in Utah, the Sundance Institute hosts local events and programs year-round that aim to: Connect local audiences to the Sundance Film Festival Introduce local audiences to independent film and immersive media.Explore social issues and stories from around the globe.Unite audiences and cultures through the power of storytelling.Share the filmmaker’s journey with audiences and emerging filmmakers, including students. January 12, 2026: Community Team Update We’re thrilled to bring back Local Lens, a selection of free screenings exclusively for Utah residents during the 2026 Sundance Film Festival. This year, we’re offering four in-person screenings and a choice of one online screening out of four online options for locals. 2026 Sundance Film Festival Local Lens Program Claiming your spot is simple: Just add the screening to your cart when registration opens on January 14, and check out like you would with any Single Film Ticket. No payment needed — just pick your film and get ready to join us.Local Lens tickets are only available for Utah Locals, acceptable IDs will be checked at the venues to verify residency. Utah Locals are defined as residents with either a Utah Driver’s License, Utah State ID card or Utah University ID.Passes will not be scanned at Local Lens screenings. Passholders will need to reserve a ticket if they wish to attend any Local Lens screenings. Sundance Film Festival: Local Lens Summer screenings of past Festival favorites. Festival Screenings for Students Inspiring the Next Generation of Storytellers within grades 9–12. Here’s what some Utah locals have to say about past events. My fiancé and I were visiting SLC and found this event online. It was truly a highlight of our trip. The pre-screening chat with a geologist was so interesting and put things into perspective, and I loved that audience members could ask questions. It felt like an intimate hang-out with friends to watch a great film. Attendee2022 Community Screening of Fire of Love It was so meaningful to our team that we were able to do a community screening at the Utah State Correctional Facility. Of the entire week packed with so many highlights, our Community Screening was up there! It helped us think through what an impact campaign for our film could look like, and have direct conversations with the population our story touches. 2024 film team for Daughters It gave me more of a perspective to show that when it comes to how you’re feeling about things you are not alone. It was a very deep feeling when watching the film. Student2025 Screening of FOLKTALES It was such an accurate portrayal of life. The simple, chaotic, powerful, sweet, tough, joyous moments all in one. Beautiful and honestly cathartic after this year. I needed that tonight. Thank you! Attendee2021 Community Screening of Life in a Day 2020 I teach at-risk, vulnerable students at a public alternative high school. Sundance's student program offers our students a chance to participate in an exclusive event that they would rarely if ever have access to outside of school. TeacherPolaris High School It gave me hope. It showed me that change is possible. This started as a student protest and turned into something that affected the entire country and even other parts of the world. Nothing is too small if you believe in it. Student2025 Screening of Deaf President Now! My students often cannot afford to see films outside of school due to work and finances, so the opportunity to attend an international film festival that affords them this opportunity, and then extends it by providing interviews and dialogue with the filmmakers is an unforgettable experience! The students fully comprehend the individual efforts, processes, and passions of the directors and producers as real people vs. mere names in the opening and closing credits. It's really wonderful! Teacher2025 Student Screening It is hard for people living in the state of Utah to break into the industry. I will keep trying and I am thankful for the opportunity to meet others. Thanks so much.
